mechanism_claims.claim_text: Peptoid 1 and related cationic amphipathic peptoids kill MCF-7 cells primarily through plasma-membrane damage at cytotoxic concentrations.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: peptoid 1 and related cationic amphipathic peptoids evaluated in Figure 4

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=Primary cytotoxicity of anticancer peptoids in cancer cells involves plasma membrane damage

mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper keeps open possible intracellular targets at lower concentrations; do not promote a single exclusive mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CF-peptoid 1 can enter MCF-7 cells and show cytoplasmic distribution in live-cell confocal imaging without necessarily causing immediate cytotoxicity at the imaging concentration.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Localization supports cell interaction/translocation context; it is not by itself a direct intracellular target claim.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The local supplementary caption reports no typical apoptotic DNA ladder after 24 h peptoid 1 treatment, supporting a non-apoptotic primary cytotoxicity interpretation.
mechanism_claims.limitations: TIF panel was not image-quantified; only caption-level support and article text were used.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Peptoid 1 reduced tumor growth in the local breast-cancer xenograft experiment, but this is phenotype efficacy evidence rather than a molecular mechanism assay.

source_locators.locator: xml:sec=Peptoid 1 inhibits tumor growth in a clinically relevant orthotopic xenotransplantation model

mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not use the xenograft result to infer a separate molecular target.

adjudication_note: Removed automated nucleic-acid-context overclaim; mechanism is limited to source-located membrane damage, cell penetration context, negative apoptosis evidence, and in vivo phenotype support.
